import sys
import re

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    st = data[1]
    part = st[:n]

    # a1: replace parenthesized parts with underscores, then find longest segment
    outside = re.sub(r'\([^)]*\)?', '_', part)
    tokens = outside.split('_')
    a1 = max((len(t) for t in tokens if t), default=0)

    # a2: count non-empty parenthesized expressions
    matches = re.findall(r'\(([^)]*)\)?', part)
    a2 = sum(1 for m in matches if len(m) > 0)

    print(f"{a1} {a2}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
